lead: eight of the fixes share one defect: a missing, empty or undefined result counted as a score.

rows.what: grading produced no results and the log still said all tests passed
a reply with no answer scored 0.9 against a "None" placeholder gold
a blank answer against a blank reference scored full credit
mcnemar returned p = 0.0 by default when there were no discordant pairs
smape scored a missing forecast as a perfect 0
OpenReward's default GRPO reward could not tell never scored from scored 0.0
an empty document scored 1.0 on the repetition filter and was kept
grid search returned a NaN-scored combination as the best when it came first in the grid
